THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper A · Domain 2 Neuroscience · 2027 syllabus

Aim and objectives

Aim. To explain the pathology and clinical features of non-Alzheimer neurodegenerative and related dementias for MRCPsych Paper A.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Distinguish behavioural variant FTD, primary progressive aphasia variants and posterior cortical atrophy by their earliest features.
  2. Describe alpha-synuclein pathology in dementia with Lewy bodies, Parkinson's disease dementia and MSA, and apply the one-year rule.
  3. Explain prion propagation and compare sporadic with variant CJD using MRI, EEG and RT-QuIC findings.
  4. Describe HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder and neurosyphilis as treatable causes of dementia.
  5. Describe the tau pathology of chronic traumatic encephalopathy after repeated head injury.
  6. Name metabolic dementias, such as Wilson's disease and B12 deficiency, and describe cognitive change in motor neurone disease.
  7. Answer the chapter's 109 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
